            f.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_36m_ftr_light,
            f.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_36m_due_light,
            f.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_36m_adv_light,
            f.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_24m_on_light,
            f.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_24m_light,
            f.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_24m_ftr_light,
            f.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_24m_due_light,
            f.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_24m_adv_light,
            f.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_1m_on_light,
            f.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_1m_light,
            f.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_1m_ftr_light,
            f.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_1m_due_light,
            f.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_1m_adv_light,
            f.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_12m_on_light,
            f.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_12m_light,
            f.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_12m_ftr_light,
            f.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_12m_due_light,
            f.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_12m_adv_light,
            f.mdl_dte,
            f.ds,
            row_number() over(partition by s.${s_topic_field} order by f.ds desc) as rn
        FROM ${sample_table} s
        LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT
                        *
                    FROM
                        dwa_risk.dwa_risk_light_rep_ability_new_df
                    WHERE
                        to_date(to_date(ds,'yyyyMMdd')) >= ${min_ds}
                    AND
                        ds <= ${max_ds}
                    ) f
        ON
            s.${s_topic_field} = f.uid
        AND
            datediff(to_date(s.${s_mdl_dte_field}),to_date(f.ds ,'yyyyMMdd')) = 0
    ) o  WHERE rn=1;
